revision.reason: Workspace does not contain Git metadata.

metadata.analysisScope: All native entries in gZombieDefs; health/armor initialization, attacks and target damage, movement states, body-part/gear transitions, and type/mode overrides. Wave roster and schedule excluded.

units.damage: health points per event when explicitly numeric; direct kill/squish has no invented number
units.speed: mVelX internal speed per update; actual displacement may be animation-root motion
units.time: tick/update or normalized animation event position; no conversion

provenance.direct_source: Literal or direct operation in source.
provenance.derived_source: Formula or condition derived from explicit source logic.

death.ordinary: bodyHP<=0 sets 0 and plays death; boss body damage clamps at 1.

damage.condition: EatPlant is called for a valid ATTACKTYPE_CHEW target; requires an eligible action state, head, and no mind control. Chilled zombies use an 8-tick interval.

sharedRules.condition: Chilled movement

sharedRules.condition: body reanimation has _ground track and the state is not in explicit mVelX exceptions
